name: workspace

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build:vercel && pnpm --filter @workspace/app run build
scripts.vercel-build: pnpm run build && (pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push || echo '[vercel-build] DB push skipped — schema may already be up to date')
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
